investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: retained evidence acquired via curl (raw HTTP, no WebFetch/AI-markdown conversion) with a descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser. A plain curl GET of the public /event-list page returned a large HTML document with a deeply-nested Wix runtime-state blob containing the real events array. This package's collector (ingestion/city-hall-barcelona/discovery.mjs) extracts just that array value with a small, deterministic bracket-depth scanner (correctly skipping bracket characters inside JSON string values) rather than attempting to parse the entire multi-hundred-KB blob as one document.
